changes: Native solver cap 1800 seconds by default; drat-trim cap 3600 seconds; each child at most 3600 seconds, combined at most two hours per instance.
Two busy children only, solver and checker, no overlapping exploratory solver. A waiting Python parent and sequential CNF generation do not search concurrently.
Per-child address-space ceiling requested through RLIMIT_AS at 1536 MiB; no global limits or config change.
Global free floor 12e9 bytes checked before every instance.
All evidence output is exclusive-create; scratch CNF is reused. FIFO proof bytes are not stored. The FIFO pathname remains after use.
Full solver/checker output goes directly to separate files, avoiding subprocess pipe-fill deadlocks. Both logs, CNF, encoders, driver, classfile and checker get SHA-256 bindings in each receipt.
Acceptance requires solver rc 20, checker rc 0, exact s VERIFIED, no s NOT VERIFIED and no s TIMEOUT. Any unverified result stops the batch.
